messages:
anika: quick design question — new HeatCurve chart in console (latency by region). Legend currently shows full names + units: "us-east-1-prod-gpu-01 — 24.3 ms (p99)". feels noisy when 8+ series :thinking:

maya: agreed. two thoughts: 1) collapse to short labels in-legend + hover to reveal full line. 2) move small unit badge to the right with `aria-hidden` numbers? :thumbsup:

josiah: accessibility: collapsed legend must be keyboard-focusable and expose full label via `aria-label`. don't rely on hover alone.

samir: +1 on aria-label. also suggest showing only integer ms in legend (24 ms) and show precise in tooltip. keeps visual weight low.

anika: what about smoothing? HeatCurve smoothing is default on and hides spikes — ops wants clear outlier visibility for incident triage.

maya: add a per-chart smoothing toggle (global default off for alertable charts). call it "Smoothing: on/off" with microcopy: "Smooths line to reduce noise; spikes still visible in raw view." small copy.

josiah: copy tweak: instead of "ms" use "ms (p99)" maybe confusing. better: "p50/p95/p99" selector in legend header if multiple quantiles shown.

samir: UI prototype idea:
```
Legend:
- Region (color swatch) — 24 ms
- Region (hover) -> "GPU node: us-east-1-prod-gpu-01\nMean: 18.2 ms\nP99: 124.7 ms"
Smoothing toggle: [On] [Off]   [Show raw spikes]
```

designbot: a11y lint failure: color contrast for swatch labels at 12px fails AA. suggest increase weight or use a baseline separation pattern.

anika: noted. are people okay with truncating cluster ids in legend to 10 chars with ellipsis and full id in tooltip and aria-label?

maya: yes. plus keyboard control: left/right to cycle legend items, enter to 'pin' (focus chart on that series) — accessibility win.

josiah: shall we update storybook and add a test that legend truncation still exposes full text to screen readers? i'll add to my queue.

anika: thanks—I'll update the figma and post screenshots. if no objections i'll move forward with: truncate + aria-label + smoothing toggle + integer unit in legend + precise tooltip. :rocket:
